title: ZipCompressionProfileContract
description: Strongly typed schema defining the 8 golden standard ZIP Deflate compression profiles.

id.description: Unique identifier of the tier profile.

name.description: Display name of the compression tier.

deflateLevel.description: Low-level C Deflate engine compression level.

zopfliIterations.description: Graph-theoretic Zopfli shortest path iteration count.

blockSplitting.description: Whether dynamic entropy block splitting is enabled.

maxBlockSplits.description: Maximum number of block splits allowed.

targetThroughputFloorMBs.description: Target throughput gate floor in MB/s.
